name: Grade Calculator
summary: Student grade calculator and dashboard: grade overviews per subject with weighted averages and dark mode.
description: A grade calculator and dashboard for students with tools to get an overview of grades and calculate average grades per subject. It supports any numeric grading system and weighted averages, features dark mode and is fully responsive, and syncs data with an external service; a legacy version keeps data exclusively in the browser.
contains: calculates weighted averages for any numeric grading system
overview tools for grades per subject
data synced with an external service; legacy version stores data in the browser
